title: Baldr Sky: The Dive
alt: A view straight down a great round shaft of steel, with rings and a net of six-sided lines of blue light on its wall, to a bright place far below. A white machine with a blue head and blue bands, seen from behind, dives down the shaft with blue fire at its back and heels. It holds a blade of light in one hand and fires a gun with the other. Dark machines with red lights come up in a swarm at the left, some in orange fire. Flat plates with rings of light float in the shaft.
summary: A painting of a dive into the virtual world from Baldr Sky in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the virtual world of Baldr Sky, a visual novel with action by Giga. In it people fight in machines that are called simulacrums. They fight each other, and they fight viruses, which are machines with no one in them.

The white machine is Kagerou, the simulacrum of Kou Kadokura. He is a mercenary, and he looks for the truth about the day that is called Gray Christmas. We see Kagerou from behind as it dives. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
